metadata.title: Dynamical evolution of stellar binaries in galactic centers

notes: The paper models a synthetic population of stellar binaries around Sgr A* and discusses hypervelocity stars, the S-star cluster, and related populations only generically. Its use of “unbound” refers to a binary becoming unbound from the central massive black hole, not to an identified star being unbound from the Milky Way. No individual star is identified as a Galactic unbound candidate or studied as follow-up to such a prior identification.
